label: رسمي

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: PlayStation Store UAE listing, release 18/11/2026 20:00 UTC (00:00 Dubai, 19 Nov); PlayStation Store Saudi listing, 18/11/2026 21:00 UTC (00:00 Riyadh); Xbox Store UAE and Saudi list 18/11/2026 with no hour; all read 11 Nov 16:50Z. Rockstar Support's regional times page answered 503 on 11 Nov 17:25Z. RE-READ all three stores and Rockstar Support on 18 Nov before 20:00 Dubai (series rule 5); change the Xbox line if a time is given
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: our pre-load Reel of 9 Nov gave pre-load times, not unlock times
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: hook midnight in Dubai; why now launch eve; for players here the hour in Dubai and Riyadh; payoff hours to go
reel_check.STORY TYPE event: yes: Dubai time and Riyadh time, from the store; where: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: «منتصف الليل في دبي موعد فتح GTA VI. تُفتح على PS5 في الإمارات منتصف الليل، وفي السعودية منتصف الليل بتوقيت الرياض. لم يحدد متجر Xbox الساعة بعد. تبقى ساعات على الإطلاق.» No line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: تُفتح for the unlock hour (not a release-date verb)
reel_check.STORY: names: yes: PS5 and Xbox in English
reel_check.SENSITIVE: yes, none: the club and pool party shots of the Extended Look left out
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: Rockstar's Launch Trailer music stem from 3.0 s (music_only, its narration removed); episode 1 used the IGN copy from 28.7, the intro uses its picture only
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Rockstar's Extended Look master (stream reads)
